title: 25331 IH 10 West

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at 25331 IH 10 West, near the intersection of IH 10 and Ralph Fair Road.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Texas Dept. of Transportation 2024 traffic maps indicate 75,631 vehicles per day on IH 10, and 9,629 vehicles per day on the frontage road north of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: There are many amenities in the immediate area, which include HEB, banks, hotels, and many restaurants.

comments: Great visibility and excellent location in the far NW submarket

qa_notes: Cover prints no street address - only 'RETAIL AND OFFICE SPACE / FOR LEASE / SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS'. Title '25331 IH 10 West' is taken from the Location row and the Demographic Overview heading; eyebrow is the cover headline minus 'FOR LEASE', which is captured as transaction.
Address typo on the retail floor plan (p9): the Jordan Group title block reads '32255 IH 10 WEST' - digits scrambled vs. 25331 IH 10 West. Buyer-facing; flag to broker.

Office availability contradiction: Size row says Office Building '+/- 975 sf to +/- 10,000 sf', but the Office Building Detail (p8) marks Suites 105, 201 and 215 'Leased' and shows only Suite 101 4,620 sf + Suite 210 975 sf + Suite 220 1979 sf = 7,574 sf available. The 10,000 sf maximum may be stale.
Retail size: spec '+/- 1,200 to +/- 6,700 sf' (note the missing 'sf' after 1,200 compared with the office line); floor plan title block says '6,701 SF' (consistent).

Prismic: size_label 'Up to 16,700 SF' (= 10,000 + 6,700, see the availability issue above); total_price 'Contact Broker' matches Pricing; transaction_type 'Lease' matches; title '25331 IH 10 West' matches the Location row; zoning null (PDF has no zoning row). Prismic highlights 'Office Bldg: 975 - 10,000 SF' / 'Retail Bldg: 1,200 - 6,700 SF' paraphrase the Size row.

Demographic Overview typos: the income section heading reads '2024 Household Income' (every other heading on the page, and every other package, says 2025); 3.0-mile Average Household Income prints '176,539' without the '$' (spec-page table shows '$176,539'). Transcribed as printed.
Spec-page demographics (7,448 / 33,695 / 59,952; 8,025 / 36,832 / 66,564; $172,248 / $176,539 / $169,713) match the Demographic Overview values.
Aerial headers give the site as '3.86 AC +/-'; no acreage appears anywhere in the spec rows.
Contact block names only Matt Howard (single email).
Pages 3, 4, 8 and 9 have no text layer; classified from the renders. Pages 3-4 carry no heading, so their captions are ''.

Demographics table row labels print as 'Population' with indented '2025 Estimate:' / '5 Year Projection:'; flattened to 'Population, 2025 Estimate' etc. per the schema example. Demographic Overview column headers print with trailing colons, dropped per schema convention.
